mechanistic_anchor.role: high-resolution historical plus contemporary mechanism anchor
mechanistic_anchor.reason: Campanula history, mating-system channels, contemporary network structure, and prospective SVD/reproductive-dependency measurements can be linked at unusually high resolution.

analysis_rule: Estimate source-native within-system effects first; compare effects across systems second. Do not pool community networks, population contrasts, sister-taxon comparisons, reproductive experiments, and historical records as exchangeable raw rows.

next_external_gate.requirement: Obtain compatible uncertainty for the same response/exposure family in at least two independent system clusters before opening a formal cross-system model, and do not count a starting-size effect as formally admissible while its measurement-error sensitivity or source provenance is unresolved.
next_external_gate.current_state: The checked effect registry has two eligible system clusters but no effect family represented with compatible uncertainty in both clusters. Southwest Pacific starting-size slopes remain blocked by shared-denominator measurement-error coupling. Hendriks 2019 now supplies a complete 35-pair numeric reconstruction that reproduces the reported OLS slope, but its source artifact is not checksum locked and an SMA pair-bootstrap sensitivity includes the isometry slope of 1.
next_external_gate.reason: Hendriks 2019 is now the closest same-response replication: all 35 Appendix B Table B9 flower-area pairs have been numerically reconstructed from the indexed author upload; the reconstructed direct ln(island) versus ln(mainland) OLS slope is 0.5833 versus the reported 0.58. Formal admission remains closed until the underlying source artifact and sampling hierarchy are locked and the error-in-variables sensitivity is resolved.

systems.geographic_design: one continental island versus one oceanic coral island
systems.admissible_question: Do shared plants experience lower visitation/partner richness and pollinator-assemblage turnover on the oceanic island?
systems.forbidden_promotion: Do not call visitation FDQ, trait matching, pollinator effectiveness, effective dependency, or replicated island-origin causation.
systems.next_gate: Obtain a second independent system with the same visit-network response/exposure family and compatible uncertainty.

systems.geographic_design: four oceanic islands with site, forest, anole and seasonal contexts
systems.admissible_question: How do invasion and habitat contexts restructure legitimate interactions within an oceanic archipelago?
systems.forbidden_promotion: Do not use Ogasawara as a direct mainland-distance replicate or infer per-visit effectiveness from interaction counts.
systems.next_gate: Obtain replicated site identifiers or another independently replicated invasion transition before causal anole-effect inference.

systems.geographic_design: ten oceanic islands with area, isolation, age and sampling effort
source_native_units: published island network summaries and model predictions; raw island networks remain blocked
systems.admissible_question: How well do the published AIS and null predictions track observed island nestedness after explicitly auditing sampling effort and island context?
systems.forbidden_promotion: Published summary tables do not provide plant-level partner turnover, adaptive causation, pollinator effectiveness, or effective dependency.
systems.next_gate: Recover data_galapagos_islands.zip or a provenance-matched author/institutional copy before raw plant-level network analyses.

systems.geographic_design: 129 source-defined island-endemic versus mainland-relative colonisation events across ten archipelagos
systems.admissible_question: Does island-mainland flower-size response depend on mainland starting size, how heterogeneous is that relationship across source-defined pollination modes and archipelagos, and how sensitive is the response-shape estimate to shared-denominator measurement error?
systems.forbidden_promotion: Sister-taxon morphology is not contemporary network function or direct effective dependency. A robust animal slope plus an uncertain wind slope is not itself a robust between-mode difference. Starting-size slopes must not enter a formal cross-system model while mainland-size reliability remains unidentified.
systems.next_gate: Recover an independent raw paired-flower dataset that supports a measurement-error-aware same-family analysis.

systems.source_type: Victoria University of Wellington MSc thesis, author-uploaded full text currently indexed through ResearchGate
systems.geographic_design: 65 island endemic-mainland sister pairs overall across New Zealand and southwest Pacific islands; flower-area subset n=35
systems.admissible_question: Can the independent New Zealand/southwest-Pacific flower-area sister-pair data reproduce a starting-size-dependent island response when analysed directly on paired island and mainland values, and how sensitive is that response to errors-in-variables treatment?
systems.forbidden_promotion: Do not treat the reported or reconstructed OLS slope below isometry as measurement-error-free. Do not enter this same-family effect into the formal registry before the source artifact, island/family hierarchy, and error-in-variables sensitivity are resolved.
systems.next_gate: Recover a stable institutional or author-distributed source artifact and checksum; verify all 35 Table B9 values; recover island/family grouping; then rerun OLS, SMA and clustered uncertainty.

systems.geographic_design: 556 species forming 136 phylogenetically independent island-mainland sister-taxon contrasts across seven tropical and subtropical Pacific island systems
systems.admissible_question: Can an independent Pacific sister-taxon dataset reproduce a compatible flower-size island-mainland response family, including context heterogeneity among islands and families?
systems.forbidden_promotion: Do not infer a starting-size slope, effect uncertainty, or pollinator mechanism from the abstract alone; do not enter this source in the cross-system effect registry before the source-native numeric table is recovered and audited.
systems.next_gate: Recover the source-native numeric contrast table and identify the exact flower-size scale, island/mainland orientation, sampling hierarchy, and uncertainty.

harmonisation_fields: license, version, checksum and lawful acquisition route
geological origin, island age, source distance and stepping-stone context
plant identity, lineage and hybrid status
survivor, non-establishment, hybrid-replacement or rewiring status
allowed claim level and prohibited causal interpretation
claim_boundary: External systems test recurrence and boundary conditions. They do not retroactively identify historical Bombus causation in Izu, and absolute mainland distance is not treated as a universal exposure across archipelagos.
